method: Independent direct curl status, redirect, media-type and content-hash checks; direct manager, company, regulatory-mirror and trade-press inspection; Texas PUC PDF extraction plus rendered-page inspection; acquisition-and-exit search

verifiedClaims: Ridgewood currently lists Undine as an Unrealized regulated water and wastewater utility consolidator
Crosstimbers lists Undine as an Unrealized investment dated June 2017 and headquartered in Houston
Company page supports Undine identity, 2016 public operating history and regulated Texas water and wastewater activity
Ridgewood describes investing through the Ridgewood Water & Strategic Infrastructure Fund and identifies Undine LLC as a current regulated-utility investment
Undine's July 2025 regulatory response states Texas Capital Bank provides debt only
The same response states Ridgewood Infrastructure and Crosstimbers Capital Group provide equity funding only
Regulatory mirror identifies XT Undine Co-Investment LP with Crosstimbers and a June 23, 2017 first sale
Trade report describes a marketed 2025 sale process, Ridgewood's 2017 entry, Fund I attribution and more than 20 roll-up acquisitions
It does not establish a signed definitive agreement or closing

exitSearch.result: No signed or closed Undine sale was identified. Both Ridgewood and Crosstimbers continue to classify Undine as Unrealized, so the 2025 process remains a reported marketed process rather than a pending legal ownership transfer.
